snippet.title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection | Physical Edition Pre-Order Trailer
snippet.description:
Test your might! Mortal Kombat Trilogy will be added to the Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection and the full game will be receiving a physical release. 

Pre-Order Today: http://bit.ly/DE-MKLK

More information at http://digitaleclipse.com
